subject: Fix profilebuilder skills-vs-strengths field mismatch (DEC-011 defect)
description: profilebuilder._SYSTEM tells the model to write a `skills` list and _profile_terms reads `skills`, but the canonical profile field (scorer.py:283, real profile.yaml) is `strengths`. AI-enriched skills are invisible to scoring. Fix: align profilebuilder to `strengths` (canonical) while still reading `skills` for back-compat. Gate: Nancy as-built -> Chris -> commit.
